exposure: Massive transfusion (MT) defined as transfusion of >=8 units of red blood cells (RBC) within 24 h of delivery
outcome: Haematological features (platelet count, prothrombin time, fibrinogen)
Transfusion management (units of RBC, fresh-frozen-plasma (FFP), cryoprecipitate transfused)
Time from onset of bleeding to delivery of the first RBC unit
cohort: 181 women who experienced massive transfusion for major obstetric haemorrhage in the UK between July 2012 and June 2013
finding: The coagulopathy of MT during MOH differs significantly depending on its cause, suggesting that more targeted transfusion strategies are required.
